about_the_game:
About this game

Nightmare Getaway is a first-person psychological horror game where escape is your only hope.

What begins as a curious adventure quickly spirals into terror when a mysterious entity abducts you and traps you inside its twisted house. Alone in the dark, you must navigate chilling corridors, solve puzzles, and confront horrors that blur the line between nightmare and reality.

Will you find a way out, or will the house consume you forever?

Key Features

  • Monologue & Dialogue System: Experience Ethan’s inner thoughts and growing dread as he struggles to make sense of his horrifying situation, while interacting with other voices.

  • Puzzles & Immersive Exploration: Search for items, solve puzzles, and uncover the house’s dark secrets to find your path to freedom.

  • Jumpscares & Trigger Events: Brace yourself for unexpected scares and scripted events that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

  • Psychological Horror: Immerse yourself in a chilling and unsettling environment where every shadow and sound could be your last.

  • Limited Sprint: Dash briefly to escape danger or move faster in short bursts.

  • Inspection System: Examine objects and environments in detail to uncover clues, hidden items, and secrets necessary to progress.

Story

Ethan and his friend Ryan set out to explore a forgotten, abandoned area. But when a mysterious entity drags Ethan into its nightmarish house, he’s left alone to face the horrors within. As he searches for escape, nightmares and reality begin to intertwine, and every step takes him deeper into the unknown.

Gameplay

Nightmare Getaway focuses on tense, atmospheric exploration. You’ll search for items, solve puzzles, and uncover secrets while navigating the house’s shifting, nightmarish halls. Fear doesn’t come from endless chases, but from unsettling sounds, eerie shadows, and the constant feeling that something is watching. With limited sprint and an inspection system that rewards careful observation, every step forward feels dangerous—and escape is never guaranteed.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains horror and psychological thriller elements, including scenes with intense frightening moments. Some scenes may be unsettling for younger audiences. No sexual content or graphic violence is included; the game features displays of weapons, knife bones and more. It explores themes of fear, suspense, and survival. The game may also contain flashing lights or strobe effects that could affect players with photosensitive epilepsy.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.14 Mojave
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Pro 555X / Intel Iris Plus 650, 2 GB VRAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Built-in / compatible with macOS
  • Additional Notes: Supports 3D / positional audio; headphones recommended for best experience. Contains flashing / strobe effects; may affect players with photosensitive epilepsy. Designed for keyboard & mouse; controller support is optional.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R7 360, 2 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: This game supports Windows 10 or later and macOS. Features 3D / positional audio; headphones are recommended for the best spatial experience. Single-player only, no online multiplayer or anti-cheat. Uses baked lighting and low/mid poly models, so it runs on mid-range PCs; low-end systems may experience reduced visual quality. Contains flashing / strobe effects; may affect players with photosensitive epilepsy. Designed for keyboard & mouse, controller support is optional.
